name: The Key to Freedom
summary: A small brass key has found its way to you in Searing Gorge. A few words are scratched into its head, marking it as a Dark Iron outhouse key that is not to be copied. Where it leads, you cannot yet say.

sections.title: A Marked Key
sections.body: The brass key looks simple, but for the words scratched into its head, which read Dark Iron Outhouse and warn against duplicating it. Where it leads is unknown, and the way to learn is to search Searing Gorge for a use for it.

sections.title: An Interrupted Visit
sections.body: At the wooden outhouse someone coughs and asks who it is, annoyed at being disturbed. Delighted that you found the key, the occupant, Locheed, says the Dark Irons hid it after locking him in.

faq.q: What is written on the Grimesilt Outhouse Key?
faq.answer: Its head is scratched with the words Dark Iron Outhouse and a warning not to duplicate it.
That is for you to find out. The key marks itself as belonging to a Dark Iron outhouse, and a use for it is to be found somewhere in Searing Gorge.
